scene: A single surviving limestone relief fragment shows the head and shoulders of an ancient Egyptian ruler in profile, wearing a simple tall white crown. The portrait is carved shallowly into the flat face of the stone; it is clearly an archaeological object, not a living person. Warm weathered stone, small chips at the slab edges, plain ivory backdrop. No writing or glyphs remain in this cropped fragment. The relief is a general educational illustration, not a claimed reproduction of a named artifact.
alt: A weathered stone relief shows the head and shoulders of a crowned ruler in profile.
